title: 最后一行公式
intervalConvention: All frame intervals are half-open [startFrame, endFrame).

acts.title: The Ptolemaic Patchwork
acts.visualAction: A dense, purely 2D epicycle drawing and technical diagrams accumulate on warm drafting paper; vermilion marks show narrative conflicts.

acts.title: Occam's Razor and Compression
acts.visualAction: A flat vermilion caliper sweep strips circles in a legible sequence toward one gold circle; all movement remains 2D.

acts.title: Four Quadrants Fold Into One
acts.visualAction: Gravity contours, quantum probability, thermodynamic streamlines, and life/mind pattern graphics translate and scale into a symbolic 2D convergence.

acts.title: The Blank Page and the Childhood Star
acts.visualAction: The astrolabe contracts, then at frame 4860 resolves to one 12 px logical carbon dot with a hairline gold circle on open bone paper.

shots.title: The patched page
shots.visualAction: Build the 2D epicycle drawing and conflict diagrams, then let their marks become visually dense.

shots.title: The caliper sweep
shots.visualAction: Sweep the flat vermilion line and remove redundant circles sequentially; resolve toward a single gold circle.

shots.title: Four scientific drawings
shots.visualAction: Show four crisp 2D plots: gravity contours; quantum probability stipple/nodal pattern; thermodynamic vector flow; life/mind branching pattern.

shots.title: Convergence on paper
shots.visualAction: Translate and conformally scale the four panels inward; visually align their linework into a 2D gold-and-carbon astrolabe.

shots.title: The final compression
shots.visualAction: Fold the astrolabe inward along its symmetries until only the final contraction remains.

shots.title: The solitary dot
shots.visualAction: At frame 4860 show the single centered dot and gold hairline circle on an otherwise empty bone canvas; hold space for the closing thought.

sfxEvents.brief: Tactile mechanical drafting pencil on paper with pocket-watch escapement tick.
Clockwork gears slightly out of phase with sharp vermilion error ticks.
A clean caliper slice sweeps across the stereo field.
Mechanical rings unlock and dissolve into a pure golden sine tone.
Four distinct frequencies slide into a single unison golden chord.
Precision horological lock click with resonant harmonic tail.
A high, pure tuning-fork overtone fades toward stillness.
Absolute silence begins; no narration, music, or SFX samples in [4860,4890).
Single fountain-pen nib touch on paper; warm nostalgic solo piano follows.

covers.description: Four 2D quadrants converging into the golden astrolabe on bone paper.
Vast bone-white canvas with the solitary Q.E.D. dot.
